articles.title: Aztec

articles.title: Fleur-de-Lis (Alt)
articles.summary: Faint damask fleur-de-lis in soft low-contrast relief, micro texture, subtle tonal repeat. Reads as a very busy multicolour mosaic of green, pink and cream on dark; no lily shape survives, only candy-coloured stripes of dots.
articles.what: Subtle damask-style repeating French lily in soft relief — refined on satin or pearl bases Up close: Dense rows of chunky pixel shapes about 16 px tall: green and cream round blobs between pink, purple and gold spade or lily-like shapes, with thin pale rules and diagonal pinstripes between the rows. Everything is in loud baked colours on near-black. A faint horizontal seam shows near mid-height. From a distance: Reads as a very busy multicolour mosaic of green, pink and cream on dark; no lily shape survives, only candy-coloured stripes of dots. Group: Cultural, World & Dark. Texture detail: micro.
how: Click a zone card and open the PATTERN section.
Click Pattern 1 on this Layer to open the picker.
Open the group "Cultural, World & Dark" or search for "Fleur-de-Lis (Alt)", then click it.
Drag Scale below 1.00 until the repeats look fine on the car.
Switch Paint mode to Blend if you want to keep your paint colour.
tips: Hood and doors: neat rows read on flat panels
Do not put under other busy graphics
Too busy for numbers; use a solid plate behind them.
Dark
Pairs well with: pearl white, champagne silver, soft grey, pale ivory.
pitfalls: Not the subtle low-contrast damask relief that the description promises: this render is loud and multicolour
Not the main Fleur-de-Lis, which is one huge taupe lily motif
Avoid: invisible on flat matte, lost under strong graphics.
